title: Why Do Helicopters Hover?
narration: This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do Helicopters Hover.
The air pushes the helicopter up.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Balance that push with weight and it hovers.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
Pilots adjust the blades many times a second.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Spinning blades push air down.
The pictures today are a new rocket world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do helicopters hover.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
